timezone_note: Displayed ECB timestamps preserved; time zone not stated on the page; UTC conversion not verified.
attribution_note: t2s_business_date follows the rule in attribution_basis. Evening entries about night processes are attributed to the next T2S settlement day; this is a labelled inference from the UDFS schedule, not source text. Weekend calendar dates carry closure/maintenance statements and are not T2S business days.
currency_note: ECB entries are not currency-specific unless the text names a currency (see currency_mentioned per entry); scope ALL means the statement concerns the operating day as a whole.

entries.original_text: T2S is closed. The T2S operator is performing internal testing activities in the production environment during the weekend maintenance window of 11 â 12 July. Normally, during the maintenance window, instructions are queued. Due to the testing activities, messages via SWIFT towards T2S during the testing period between Saturday at 05:00 CEST until, maximum, to Sunday at 13:00 CEST, will be rejected with the NACK status. T2S Actors will need to resend any rejected messages to T2S once the maintenance window has closed with the early reopening on Sunday, 12 July at 23:00 CEST.
entries.attribution_basis: calendar date used as business date (daytime entry, or routine/closure status)
